kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-count-for-each
-- base/main.tf --
module "child" {
  source = "./modules/child"
  names  = ["a"]
}
-- base/modules/child/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  for_each = toset(var.names)
  name     = each.value
}

variable "names" {
  type = list(string)
}
-- head/main.tf --
module "child" {
  source = "./modules/child"
  names  = ["a", "b"]
}
-- head/modules/child/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  for_each = toset(var.names)
  name     = each.value
}

variable "names" {
  type = list(string)
}
